description: [Free] The proof behind a film: the format version that made it (template SHA-256), every resolver source and what it fetched, the integrity report, the claim ledger (which figures trace to the page, the brief or nothing), the Content Credentials (C2PA), and a check recompiling the stored data against the narration word for word.

episode_id.description: The episode to verify, from run_show or a show's recent_episodes.

video_id.description: Or a video id: the episode is found through it when there is one; a plain video is verified on its claim ledger and credentials.
